players.product: silicon-photonics foundry services (PH18 SiPho platform) + SiGe drivers/TIAs

quarterly_data.signal: 6-K release: Tower announced, with support from the Government of Japan, a parallel dual-track expansion of 300mm SiPho, SiGe and advanced packaging capabilities in Japan; the scope is forecast to be 'an approximate $3 billion Tower's investment, net of grants of $1 billion, to be provided by the Government of Japan'. Track one repurposes the Arai facility (formerly Fab 6) for 300mm SiPho capacity and advanced packaging and maximizes Fab 7 300mm output in Uozu, with full production readiness expected during the fourth quarter of 2027; track two, starting in parallel after related agreements are signed and closed, adds a 300mm manufacturing facility adjacent to Fab 7 for a multi-fold increase in SiPho and SiGe capacity and is expected to be highly accretive beginning in 2029. CEO Russell Ellwanger: 'We anticipate track two to provide the path for continued growth far beyond 2028.'
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $3 billion investment, net of $1 billion Government of Japan grants; track one ready in the fourth quarter of 2027; new fab highly accretive from 2029
